en: A colorized landscape view of a large riverside or lakeside estate surrounded by dense coniferous forest and open fields. The central building is a sizable multi‑story structure with a tower or belvedere topped by a flagpole flying a tricolor flag. The structure resembles a manor or palace complex with several wings and outbuildings. In the background lie broad waters, gently rolling countryside, and more forest under a lightly clouded sky. There is a wide cream‑colored border typical of early 20th‑century printed postcards, and no visible caption on the front.
